WhisperOfTheForest.Rituals.RitualDef.label: rite of clear skies
WhisperOfTheForest.Rituals.RitualDef.description: The caster traces a green chalk ring and parts the clouds above the altar. Clear skies settle in after the rite and last until the weather turns on its own.

WhisperOfTheForest.Rituals.RitualDef.label: rite of rain
WhisperOfTheForest.Rituals.RitualDef.description: The caster traces a green chalk ring and calls a gentle rain over the altar. The rain settles in after the rite and lasts until the weather turns on its own.

WhisperOfTheForest.Rituals.RitualDef.label: rite of thunderstorm
WhisperOfTheForest.Rituals.RitualDef.description: The caster traces a star chalk ring and calls a thunderstorm down over the altar. The storm settles in after the rite and lasts until the weather turns on its own.
